availability: Free · needs a Ledge with LedgeKit 0.25 · macOS 14 or later
description: Pomodoro is a focus and break timer in the notch. Choose Focus or Break, set any length from a minute to eight hours, and start it from the notch; each mode remembers its own length. There's a stopwatch too. While it runs, the time sits beside the notch with a progress ring, on the lock screen and on a Home widget that's also a tile on your iPhone, under Focus. Pause, resume or stop from any of them, or with a keyboard shortcut. When a session ends you hear the end sound you picked and see a notice, and it counts overtime with a button to start the next session, or moves on by itself. Give a session a title and play brown, pink or white noise at the volume you like. Everything stays on your Mac.
